plans.idea: Classic left-to-right banner read: bottle, then headline over subhead with legal tucked beneath, then a compact badge pair, ending on the CTA at the right edge.
Two-tier center block: bottle at left, a wide headline and subhead tier across the top, then a lower tier where the badges and legal share one baseline, with a large CTA closing the right end.
Message first: headline and subhead open at the left edge with legal below, the bottle sits in the middle as a visual break, and the badges and CTA form one offer cluster on the right.
